membrane_protection.description: Ability to preserve membrane structure, lipid organization, vesicle integrity, and resistance to aggregation or rupture.

protein_protection.description: Ability to preserve protein folding, solubility, and functionality.

nucleic_acid_protection.description: Ability to preserve DNA/RNA integrity and downstream amplifiability.

oxidative_protection.description: Ability to reduce oxidative damage to biomolecules.

vitrification.description: Potential to form glass-like protective states or reduce molecular mobility.

molecular_crowding.description: Contribution to crowding, viscosity, and restricted diffusion.

mineralization_support.description: Potential to support biomineralization, encapsulation, or inorganic protective matrices.

pcr_compatibility.description: Expected compatibility with PCR and qPCR workflows.

lcms_compatibility.description: Expected compatibility with LC-MS proteomics and metabolomics workflows.

availability_score.description: Ease of sourcing from commercial suppliers.

evidence_count.description: Number of curated evidence records supporting the material.
